theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_etp_localization
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (Z : Set (Euclid P)) (s₁ : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < s₁ → (∀ x ∈ Z, dist x a < s₁ → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ ≤ 1 / 20 * dist x a) → ∃ s₀ : ℝ, 0 < s₀ ∧ s₀ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ (∀ s' : ℝ, 0 < s' → s' ≤ s₀ → ∀ x ∈ Z, 0 < inner ℝ x a → |‖x‖ - 1| < s' → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ ≤ 2 * s₀ * ‖x‖ → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s' / 4 * ‖x‖ ∧ dist x a < 3 * s')
